The United States’ GDP per capita in 1850 was about $3,000 in 2011 PPP dollars, so the answer is B. Maddison’s figure of roughly $1,800 in 1990 international dollars scales to that 2011 level, and it matches long-run US real growth from the mid-19th century to about $50,000 in 2011. That is several times a bare-subsistence income of roughly $700 a year.

CONFIDENCE: 86
